about: Nectovia's plain-writing rules: the one list the checker reads (shared/plain-writing.ts). Seeded from the website's copy gate (diomedes-site scripts/copy-rules.mjs BANNED and scripts/check-copy.mjs voice rules). To add a phrase, add it to stockPhrases in lower case and bump the version. A person can also add phrases for their own installation in Settings; those are kept in settings, not here.

contrastPatterns.what: contrast framing "It's not X. It's Y."
contrast framing "not just X but Y"

contrastNote: A plain correction such as "Friday, not Thursday" is left alone on purpose: the site bans every ", not", but in an answer about a business that form is usually the fact the reader needs. Add a pattern here to ban it.

hedges.note: A sentence is flagged when it holds two or more hedges and at least one is an adverb or phrase. Two modals alone ("you may want to check whether it could be late") are ordinary English. "May" counts only in lower case, so the month is never a hedge.
